definitions.explanation: A person descended from a particular ancestor; future generations.

examples.english: He is a descendant of samurai.

examples.japanese: {子孫|しそん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{伝|つた}える→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧。
{子孫|しそん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{残|のこ}したい→残す：01975_nokosu⟧。
examples.english: I want to leave a good environment for future generations.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{家系|かけい}→家系：10130_kakei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{子孫|しそん}⟦{繁栄|はんえい}→繁栄：10131_han_ei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{願|ねが}って→願う：02387_negau⟧⟦{建|た}てられた→建てる：01189_tateru⟧。
examples.english: This house was built with wishes for the prosperity of descendants.

examples.japanese: {子孫|しそん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ために→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦たち→たち：10079_tachi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{責任|せきにん}→責任：03298_sekinin⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I believe it is our responsibility to protect nature for future generations.

notes:
{子孫|しそん} refers to descendants or future generations of a family line.

Common collocations:
- {子孫|しそん}を{残|のこ}す (to leave descendants)
- {子孫|しそん}{繁栄|はんえい} (prosperity of descendants)
- {子孫|しそん}に{伝|つた}える (to pass down to descendants)
- 〜の{子孫|しそん} (descendant of ~)

Antonym: {先祖|せんぞ} / {祖先|そせん} (ancestor)

Related words:
- {末裔|まつえい} (descendant - more literary)
- {後裔|こうえい} (descendant - formal)
- {子々孫々|ししそんそん} (descendants for generations)
